option_relations.rationale: IgG4-related rhinosinusitis is a specific manifestation of IgG4-Related Disease. The option also includes a concurrent bacterial infection, which is not directly related to the IgG4-RD leaf but doesn't negate the subtype relationship for the IgG4-related rhinosinusitis component.
The option 'IgG4-related disease' is clinically equivalent to the leaf 'IgG4-Related Disease'.
IgG4-Related Disease (IgG4-RD) with Orbital/Sinus Involvement is a specific presentation or subtype of the broader IgG4-Related Disease.

Invasive bacterial rhinosinusitis with orbital apex syndrome is a distinct condition from IgG4-Related Disease, although some symptoms might overlap. The underlying pathology and etiology are different.
